summary: Build the in-process recurrent no-spec single-step DECODE oracle (deployment-correct, sidesteps the streamed off-by-one) and re-score BOTH arms (native E5, our spine chain5, cat9) full-stream vs it, on the SAME banked served streams that were scored vs chunked. Decide frame (both arms move consistently, gap shrinks) vs real-defect (ours-only moves). User decides adopt after; this just produces the numbers.

build.oracleScript: /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr13_recurrent_decode_oracle.py (508 lines, committed a62b454f, pathspec-only — concurrent worker's scripts/fr13_shape_sweep_workflow.js + tests/test_fr13_gdn_subop_mab_wiring.py NOT swept). Standalone: boots stock vLLM via offline LLM() (NOT the fr10_phase4 tree patcher), no speculative_config, FLASH_ATTN, enforce_eager, max_num_seqs=1, VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0. It carries ssm_state/conv_state forward per single-token step by forcing each served token as a max_tokens=1 GREEDY decode: a registered v1 AdapterLogitsProcessor (ForcedRecurrentAdapter) returns a per-request callable that, at decode step i, (1) reads the CLEAN recurrent argmax+top-k from the logits row produced by that step's recurrent forward, then (2) overwrites logits to make served[i] the unique argmax so the engine COMMITS served[i] and advances the conv/ssm state held in the KV cache to step i+1. State is never re-prefilled per position; it rolls forward across decode steps exactly as deployment does. Two subcommands: smoke (prove path + reproduce q1 pinned stream) and rescore (per-arm full-stream both-arm flip re-score = next GPU phase). Per-step clean records are written to a per-request /logs JSONL (extra_args sink_path) so the engine-core worker -> driver transport is filesystem-based.

build.recurrentPathProof: Confirmed by reading live container source vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/gdn_linear_attn.py: _forward_core L807-817 routes to _forward_core_decode_non_spec when enable_packed_recurrent_decode(default True via VLLM_ENABLE_FLA_PACKED_RECURRENT_DECODE) AND spec_sequence_masks is None AND num_prefills==0 AND num_decodes>0; that function (L1045-1110) runs causal_conv1d_update(conv_state) + fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode(initial_state=ssm_state) = the rank-1 recurrent roll. gdn_attn.py L201 split_decodes_and_prefills(decode_threshold=1) => num_decodes counts query_len==1 seqs; num_prefills>0 (the only chunked branch, L880 chunk_gated_delta_rule) requires query_len>1. The oracle forces ONE token per generate step so every post-prefill forward has query_len==1 => num_decodes>0, num_prefills==0 => recurrent. EMPIRICALLY PROVEN by the smoke test: a monkeypatch counter on _forward_core_decode_non_spec recorded recurrent_decode_calls=1104 over 24 generated tokens = 46.0/token (the 46-48 GDN linear_attn layers firing once per recurrent decode step), RECURRENT_PATH_ENGAGED=true, n_gdn_layers_introspected=96. Zero calls would FAIL-LOUD (class-9 vacuous-oracle gate). Reproduces the EXACT q1 pinned path: no-spec recurrent argmax at pos21 = 3425 (clean ' files') vs tree-served 1970 ('verify-flipped'), with served[:21] reproduced byte-exact (match_first21=true) — the documented q1 deep-row flip (recurrent=3425 vs tree=1970).
build.offByOneSidestepped: The HTTP instrument streams a served array and indexes served[:i] per re-prefilled request, where a +/-1 misalignment between the streamed token array and the position being scored is the streamed off-by-one (it also re-chunks the suffix). The recurrent oracle never indexes a streamed array to build the conditioning: the logits processor reads the distribution for step i DIRECTLY inside that step's recurrent forward (the row that predicts position i, conditioned on the state rolled forward through served[0..i-1] which were each forced at their own step). step index == len(past_token_ids), so served[step] and the clean argmax for that exact step are paired in-band, in the same call, with no separate streamed-array lookup. The prompt is prefilled once and NOT scored; only generated positions are scored. So there is no cross-array index to be off-by-one, and the partial-suffix re-chunk is gone.
